## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm run test:coverage` pass locally (coverage stays at or above 90 %)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change, if applicable
- [ ] New or changed tool input has a case in `test/mcp/validation.test.ts`
- [ ] New or changed API calls have a contract test in `test/contract/` (`npm run spec:check` passes)
- [ ] README updated, if this changes setup, configuration, or the tool list
- [ ] `mcpb/manifest.json` updated, if a tool was added or renamed
- [ ] A changeset was added via `npx changeset`, if this is user-facing (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#changelog-entries))
